objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-file-and-directory-permissions-remove-inheritance
objects.description: The following analytic detects the removal of permission inheritance using ICACLS. This analytic identifies instances where ICACLS is used to remove permission inheritance from files or directories. The /inheritance:r flag, which strips inherited permissions while optionally preserving or altering explicit permissions, is monitored to detect changes that may restrict access or establish isolated permission configurations.
